summary: Trinity County, CA lookout with staffing from 1911; burned in the Monument Fire on August 13, 2021. A 2021 rebuild request had no answer.

notes_for_editor: No build year found in the sources read; the earliest dated staffing (1911) starts the story. Brief record height_m 4.3 (14 ft) has no source in this pass, and the 1961 geodetic station description on the Forest Lookouts page gives the building as 20 feet high; check before publishing. The FFLOS page gives the site entry registration as May 22, 2022, so that event is added from cite 2. In the Register text the Greg comment sits under the June 23, 2019 visit report heading, so the story attributes it to that report. The run's web search budget was used up before this tower could be searched, so nothing is sourced on the site today or on any rebuild after 2021. Access left out (brief says unknown).
